motion.name: grow
motion.value: 200ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), clip-path from the launcher footprint
motion.purpose: Launcher grows into the panel on an opaque surface; glass switches on at the end. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: log-unfold
motion.value: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr and margin over 200ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); opacity 150ms ease-out; content slides 4px (translateY(-4px) to 0) over 200ms
motion.purpose: The request log opens and closes under its row with the same animation. Off under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow-panel
breakpoints.value: rendered panel width under 440px (ResizeObserver; resize range 400-720px, or a squeezing viewport): picker column and pill 112px, log button column stays 28px

darkScheme.trigger: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) unless the host has data-theme="light", or :host([data-theme="dark"]). Token overrides only. Launcher and header stay solid navy #1F2A44.

extensions.forcedColors: Overridden pill gets a 2px Highlight border; select, footer buttons, search and the request-log button use ButtonText edges; grip uses CanvasText; launcher focus box-shadow removed.

accessibility.textContrast: 4.5:1 or better over a black host
accessibility.controlEdge: 3:1 or better over a black host
accessibility.reducedMotion: grow, tint and unfold off (all transitions none)

extensions.heightHold: While a search or the overridden filter is active the panel keeps its current height as min-height; cleared when both are inactive.

narrative.overview: One colour in this overlay means a single thing: this route is faked differently right now. Mustard appears wherever that is true and nowhere else, on an otherwise calm panel of slate navy and frosted off-white. Header and launcher are always solid navy, in both themes; the body is frosted glass held at a 0.92 floor with no saturation boost. System fonts only, 14px minimum, mono for API facts, pill controls, soft radii. No target mark. It rejects the grey devtools drawer with method-coloured badges; method is plain mono text and colour is reserved for state.
keyCharacteristics: Mustard (override) and brick (error) are the only two state colours; each has exactly one job.
Solid navy header and launcher, frosted body, solid white fields with visible edges.
System fonts only, 14px body, nothing under 14px, mono for API facts.
Pill controls, 10px row and field radii, 12px panel radius.
Motion is three short moves (launcher growing into the panel, the picker tinting, the request log unfolding), all off under reduced motion.
Self-contained: no web fonts, images or network; overlay bundle at or under 150 kB minified.

rules.name: The One Mustard Rule
rules.body: Mustard means an override and nothing else. It is never decoration, never a hover, never a brand flourish. If nothing is overridden, no mustard is on screen.

rules.name: The Words-Beside-Brick Rule
rules.body: Brick never stands alone. An error carries an icon or a word so it survives colour-blindness and forced colors.

rules.name: The Black-Host Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text meets 4.5:1 and control edges meet 3:1, measured with the panel over a black host page, the worst case for glass. Solid navy surfaces are exempt because they do not depend on the host.

rules.name: The Fourteen Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is smaller than 14px (raised from 13px on 2026-11-22 for legibility). Sizes are always in px so the host page's root font-size cannot leak in.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Facts Rule
rules.body: Method, path, timing, status, URL and shortcut are mono. Everything that talks to the developer is sans.

rules.name: The Solid-Anchors Rule
rules.body: The header and launcher are always solid navy, never glass, so the tool is identifiable over any host.

rules.name: The Flat-Inside Rule
rules.body: Nothing inside the panel casts a shadow. Depth inside is a hairline or a tonal fill.

dos: Do use mustard (`#E8B93A`) solely for overrides: the tinted scenario pill, the solid launcher chip and the solid collapsed-group chip. Put Slate Navy text on it.
Do use brick (`#9E3328`) solely for errors, and pair it with an icon or word.
Do keep the header and launcher solid navy, and the glass body at or above 0.92 with `blur(14px) saturate(0)`.
Do keep every control edge at 3:1 or better and text at 4.5:1, measured over a black host.
Do use system fonts only: the rounded stack for chrome, mono for paths, numbers and shortcuts; 14px body and minimum, sizes in px.

Do keep everything inside the closed shadow root with no web fonts, images or network requests, and the overlay bundle at or under 150 kB minified. Follow the OS light/dark setting unless the user picked a theme with the header button (Auto / Light / Dark, saved).
Do give every control a visible edge in forced colors, and turn off the grow, tint and unfold motion under reduced motion; fall back to an opaque panel under reduced transparency.
Do copy PRODUCT.md voice: dry wit in empty states, exact and actionable in errors.
donts: Don't use mustard for anything that is not an override (no hover states, accents or decoration).
Don't colour HTTP methods or add method-coloured badges.
Don't let brick appear without an icon or a word.
Don't make the header or launcher translucent, or boost glass saturation or lower its 0.92 floor.
Don't add a target, crash-test or other mark to the overlay; the owner removed it.
Don't add shadows inside the panel, web fonts, icon packages or raster images.
Don't set anything below 14px or in rem/em.
